the_monotone_decay_is_linear_model_speci.conclusion: the six-fold decay is a property of the linear model, not of the information structure

a_convention_I_had_to_fix: in the no_identity condition every evaluation row carries the reserved identity code, so the identity arm predicts a constant and its rank correlation is undefined; a constant scorer carries no rank information, so it is scored zero. This is stated rather than hidden.
limits: thirty splits, and the no_identity interval is wide, so 'no evidence of growth' is not 'no growth'
the reserved code is one representation of a missing identity
the cross-model magnitude comparison was not tested formally
the tree was not tuned, so 'the tree extracts less' remains provisional
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: give the tree a fair chance with more iterations, smaller leaves or a category-aware implementation before concluding that the substitution effect is linear-only
